59d9b8fb-9780-45d7-bb98-8b406bc64d6d.quote: The lane sheet read unfavored early in the carry, offlane, and jungle matchups, and favored in mid and support, but first blood came to us at 2.6 when Khaimera caught Wraith. Kallari was caught out 1.3 minutes later. The game turned at 11.2: three of us won 4-1 at their Outer Tower while Murdock and Khaimera were elsewhere as we took the Mini Prime across the map - two prizes at once. We gave one back at 13.5, losing a contested Fangtooth fight 2-3 after Murdock's solo death at 12.8 and a second death from Sparrow inside the fight. From there it was one-sided: a 3-1 win at their Inhibitor at 19.7, then the match-ending push through Fangtooth between 21.1 and 22.0 that finished the game 6 towers to 0 in 22 minutes.
